title: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, 1:5M, 2020: units coloured by period (equirectangular)
credit: USGS Astrogeology Science Center: Fortezzo, Spudis and Harrel (2020), Unified Geologic Map of the Moon; shading from the NASA LRO colour map
alt: Map of the whole Moon coloured by the age of its surface: purple oldest highlands, blue and green basins, gold younger lava plains and pale yellow young craters.
derived: 64 px/degree unit raster -> 4096 x 2048 nearest; each unit's Unit_Age (the younger bound for a two-period unit) -> one of 5 colours; times the LRO colour map's brightness.

title: Moon LRO LOLA Color Shaded Relief 388m v4 (equirectangular)
credit: USGS Astrogeology Science Center, from the LRO LOLA elevation model (NASA Goddard Space Flight Center)
alt: Map of the whole Moon coloured by height: blue and purple low basins, green plains, orange and red high far-side highlands, with craters shaded in relief.
